title: 2014 AMC 10B Problem 1
statement: Leah has \(13\) coins, all of which are pennies and nickels. If she had one more nickel than she has now, then she would have the same number of pennies and nickels. In cents, how much are Leah’s coins worth?

solutions.text:
Let the number of pennies be \(p.\) Then, the number of nickels is \(13-p\) and \(p-1,\) so \(13-p=p-1.\) This means we have \(7\) pennies and \(6\) nickels.

Therefore, the number of cents is \(7+6\cdot 5=37.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
